jobs.title: VP Engineering - Freedom Power
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Freedom Power Systems, Inc., is a 30 person, subsidiary of Vicor Corporation, is a leading designer and manufacturer of commercial mission-critical power systems for the aerospace and defense industries. We integrate Vicor’s advanced DC/DC converters, filters, and power circuits into complete, ruggedized power systems engineered for reliability, performance, and compliance.

We are seeking an experienced, execution-driven Vice President of Engineering to lead our engineering function and directly own project and program management execution. This role oversees a fully staffed engineering organization and is responsible for driving product development, system integration, sustaining engineering, compliance, schedule management, risk management, and disciplined program execution.

This position is 100% onsite at Cedar Park, TX

Job Description

Provide strategic and operational leadership for engineering while personally managing project and program execution.
Lead a multidisciplinary engineering team (electrical, mechanical, software/firmware, test, network).
Oversee the full product lifecycle: concept, design, prototyping, verification, qualification testing coordination, release, and sustaining.
Ensure adherence to AS9100/ISO 9001 design and development processes.
Own and actively manage program schedules, costs, risks, milestones, and cross-functional coordination.
Strengthen engineering processes, documentation, and design controls.
Partner with Operations and Quality to ensure manufacturability, compliance, and repeatability.
Support customer engagements and proposal development with technical expertise.

Education / Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or a related field; master’s degree preferred.
10+ years of engineering leadership experience in aerospace, defense, power systems, or electromechanical systems.
Proven success leading engineering teams in a manufacturing environment.
Strong understanding of system level integration involving power modules, converters, filters, thermal systems, and packaging.
Experience with regulatory and compliance standards (UL, MIL STD, FCC, CE, DO 160).
Demonstrated ability to personally manage projects and programs while delivering complex products on schedule.
Excellent communication, leadership, and decision making abilities.
This position requires access to information or technology that is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). All applicants must be U.S. persons within the meaning of ITAR."

Preferred Experience

Experience integrating modular power components.
Background in defense or aerospace product development and qualification.
Familiarity with ERP/MRP systems and engineering change processes.
Experience leading established engineering teams through organizational growth.

Why Join Freedom Power Systems?

Lead engineering and program management at a strategically important, defense-focused subsidiary of Vicor.
Guide a capable engineering team that needs strong leadership, not rebuilding.
Shape the future of mission critical power systems used in demanding aerospace and defense applications.
Competitive compensation, benefits, and long term growth opportunities.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

Vicor is an EO employer – M/F/Veteran/Disability

Compensation Data

$175,000 - $200,000

Please note: This range is based on our current market driven pay structures. Individual salaries are determined based upon a variety of factors including but not limited to, a candidates overall qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience as well as company internal equity.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. Vicor is an Equal Opportunity employer – M/F/Veteran/Disability.

jobs.title: Senior Manager Software Engineering
jobs.description:
SONIFI Health isn’t just building interactive patient technology, we’re helping healthcare organizations improve care and create better experiences. Our team is passionate about solving real healthcare challenges, reinforcing our belief that healthcare is hospitality, and supporting what patients, clinicians, and families need most in care settings. If shaping what the future of healthcare looks like in hospitals and care centers across the country sounds like where you want your talents and career to go next, we’d love to welcome you to SONIFI Health.

Help lead the teams behind the technology that supports healthcare organizations, clinicians, and patients. We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Software Engineering to provide leadership across software engineering teams, with responsibility for resource planning, development processes, software quality, delivery accountability, and the growth and performance of engineering talent.

What you’ll do

Reporting to the Director of Software Engineering, you’ll provide leadership and direction across software engineering initiatives while ensuring resources, processes, quality, and team performance support business priorities and delivery commitments.

Lead strategic resource forecasting, capacity planning, and allocation of Software Engineers, quality engineers, technical authors, and related technical contributors across multiple development programs to support business priorities, delivery commitments, and new product development. Establish and cultivate collaborative, effective relationships with counterparts to ensure adequate resource allocation to projects and maximum efficiency.
Define, lead, and evaluate development process and quality initiatives, exercising independent judgment to determine appropriate priorities, standards, and corrective actions based on project, product, customer, and business needs. Lead standards-based compliance and process improvement efforts for assigned programs, including establishing expectations, monitoring adherence, resolving issues, and making recommendations that affect engineering operations and delivery outcomes.
Participate in and ensure well-planned implementation of established software quality improvement initiatives and processes, leveraging ROI, adherence to standards, and timely, measurable results. Use metrics related to resource allocation, software quality, delivery predictability, productivity, and efficiency to assess team performance, identify risks or improvement opportunities, and make informed management decisions.
Own delivery accountability for assigned software engineering initiatives by ensuring commitments, scope, dependencies, risks, and progress against schedules are clearly defined, reasonable, proactively monitored, and escalated as appropriate. Ensure communication and status forums are structured to support effective decision-making, timely escalation of significant issues, stakeholder alignment, and accountability for initiative and team outcomes.
Identify, attract, recruit, and retain internal and external talent to build an effective mix of leadership, technical, and delivery capabilities across supported Engineering teams. Effectively onboard new employees and managers to accelerate role clarity, productivity, team integration, and performance.
Establish and manage team and individual objectives, KPIs, and performance goals that align individual accountability with department objectives, delivery commitments, quality expectations, and business priorities. Allocate workload based on each employee’s strengths, skills, and capacity; implement development plans; coach individuals to reach their maximum talent; provide regular constructive feedback; address poor or mediocre performance in a timely manner; and recognize high performers to maintain motivation and retain key talent.
Leverage effective, clear, and timely communication through available written and verbal channels, including in a global context as appropriate for the initiatives and locations involved. Regularly communicate company news and team progress against the business plan while fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and high-performing team culture that encourages accountability, engagement, and continuous improvement.

What you’ll need

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field, or the equivalent combination of education and/or experience.
Minimum of four years of experience managing software engineering teams and at least 10 years of software development experience. Management experience may include indirect leadership responsibilities, such as serving as a team lead or guiding cross-functional initiatives.
A desire to work with people and the ability to challenge Software Engineers toward self-improvement and increased technical skills, along with superior interpersonal skills and a proven ability to build effective, collaborative, cross-functional relationships and motivate team members.
Experience delivering software products through Agile development and experience leading and/or developing within a full-stack web development environment are required.
Demonstrated knowledge of modern development languages and platforms, including AWS CDK (IaC), Lambda, Step Functions, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, EventBridge, IAM, and Cognito; Python; TypeScript/JavaScript, specifically React and Redux; databases including PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and MySQL; and REST.
Healthcare industry experience building applications that support hospital clinical workflows and HL7/patient data.
History of cross-functional success collaborating with peer teams, Project and Program Management, Quality Assurance, IT, and other stakeholders, with a sense of urgency to deliver value to customers.
Self-directed and capable of working effectively in a highly innovative and fast-paced environment, with strong logical and problem-solving skills, superior attention to detail, and excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.

This position directly manages an Agile software engineering team and may manage other technical positions. Responsibilities include setting work priorities, allocating resources, establishing performance expectations, coaching and developing employees, participating in hiring and staffing decisions, completing performance reviews, and addressing performance concerns.

Some evening or weekend work may be required to meet critical project timelines, including providing direction to teams outside normal business hours when necessary. Some travel, including air and ground transportation, may also be required.

Together, we can build your future!

We offer a competitive compensation package including health, dental, vision, 401(k) with employer match, paid time off (PTO), flexible work arrangements, professional development opportunities, pet insurance, and on-demand pay. Compensation for this position generally starts at $130,000 to $180,000 annually and varies based on experience, education, specialty, training, and geographic location.

SONIFI and SONIFI Health are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered regardless of age, race, color, national origin, sex, religion, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status.

If you require assistance with the online application due to a disability, please contact Human Resources at 605-988-1000.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager Silicon Design Engineering
jobs.description:
ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.

The Role

This is a manager role for ASIC Hardware and Firmware Co-Verification Engineering role with the Security IP Team (SECIP) in AMD . The primary focus of this role is to Lead and Manage the team responsible for Hardware/Firmware co-verification of various embedded micro-processor subsystems and the associated hardware accelerators in leading edge SOC’s. The preferred candidate will also have proven experience in Firmware based HW verification and the ability to contribute to Firmware development initiatives. These IP subsystems provide high performance functions to the respective SoC, such as security policy management, cryptography, data compression, high throughput DMA, etc.

The Person

The ideal candidate has experience leading others in technical and managerial settings. You also have excellent communication, writing, and presentation skills.  

Key Responsibilities

Lead a high-performance engineering team
Form a team and nurture talent
Lead team, meet schedule commitments and provide strong support to customers
Collaborate with multi-functional leaders to drive AMD's success 
Responsible to performance review , career development for team member .
Managed the team that is responsible for implementing / executing below task
Hardware/Firmware co-verification in UVM System Verilog and C-DPI structured testbench.
Hardware/Firmware co-verification in FPGA hardware prototype platform.
Develop and maintain subsystem verification architecture, testbench, test methodology for
Embedded CPU and subcomponent IPs with
AXI/AHB busses and HW accelerators such as
Cryptography, Data Compression, DMA, etc.
Participate in subsystem specification, influence IP micro-architecture development (HW and FW co-design and verification aspect), develop and verify abstracted performance model
Create abstracted FW and HW performance models
Develop critical target code to collect IP performance key parameters
Explore subsystem architecture performance trade-off for FW and HW optimization
Drive team to Develop and execute subsystem and block level test plans
Develop FW/HW co-verification methodology
Develop UVC and System Response models
Develop and debug UVM and C-DPI test cases with integrated FW
Improve verification metrics
Further develop subsystem and block level testbenches using UVM randomized test methodology and C-DPI directed test methodology.
Develop and maintain subsystem level integration scripts
Develop and maintain subsystem testbench build and test run scripts
Drive to verification metrics closure
Interface with SoC integration and SoC DV teams
Define and develop IP level DV API to support SoC level DV effort
Develop and maintain IP build and delivery infrastructure to support SoC level integration of SMU IPs.
Support SoC level IP emulation, silicon bring-up and debugging effort

Preferred Experience

A strong leader with experience working with a distributed team 
Strong mentoring and coaching skills
Proven experience managing and leading engineering teams
Prior experience in optimizing performance (client, server, system, or embedded)
Strong system and software engineering background
Strong communications skills. Able to summarize complex problems for executives as well as drill down to details with architects and engineers
Strong analytic and problem-solving skills including the ability to analyze current behavior, identify potential areas for improvement and design of experiments
Must be a self-starter and self-motivated
Prior experience Managing technical teams

Academic Credentials

Bachelors or Masters degree in computer engineering/Electrical Engineering

LOCATION: AUSTIN TX (Open to MARKHAM, ON , OTTAWA, ON)

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

Benefits offered are described: AMD benefits at a glance.

AMD does not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee-based recruitment services. AMD and its subsidiaries are equal opportunity, inclusive employers and will consider all applicants without regard to age, ancestry, color, marital status, medical condition, mental or physical disability, national origin, race, religion, political and/or third-party affiliation, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates and will accommodate applicants’ needs under the respective laws throughout all stages of the recruitment and selection process.

jobs.title: Global Head of Specialist Solutions Architecture, Billing
jobs.description:
Who We Are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Specialist Solutions Architecture (Revenue Suite) team is dedicated to being trusted partners to Stripe customers, partners, and product/engineering teams. We focus on understanding our customers' needs and helping them achieve their business goals through our suite of revenue management solutions. Our team develops shared visions, establishes joint accountability, and prioritizes long-term success for our customers. We recognize that every customer's success increases the GDP of the internet and accelerates Stripe's growth.

What You'll Do

As the Global Head of Specialist Solutions Architecture for Revenue, you will have a significant impact on Stripe's future success. You will be responsible for building and leading the global Specialist Solutions Architecture team, with the opportunity to scale the organization as the business grows. This role combines deep product expertise with global leadership, positioning you to drive Stripe's success across all markets.

Responsibilities

Define and execute Stripe's technical sales strategy for our revenue suite in collaboration with sales leaders, marketing, professional services, GTM partner team, and product engineering.
Build repeatable playbooks and define execution best practices for our billing and revenue recognition offerings.
Recruit, mentor, develop, and inspire team members to do the best work of their careers, focusing on deep domain expertise in billing and revenue recognition.
Influence the mindset of CXOs, developers, architects, and other technical decision-makers, helping shape their long-term architectural direction for revenue management.
Champion the voice of our customers and influence product direction and priorities within the revenue management ecosystem.
Partner with Sales, Professional Services, Support, and Product Engineering to guide the customer journey from business and technical discovery to successful adoption, value realization, and expansion.
Drive thought leadership through presentations at EBCs, industry events, and by developing whitepapers and reference architectures focused on revenue management best practices.
Foster cross-regional collaboration and knowledge sharing across AMER, EMEA, and APAC to ensure consistent excellence globally.

Who you are

If you're passionate about people, ideas, and embracing the unknown, if you see setbacks as chances to learn and grow, and if you believe in the power of focused effort to drive progress—then this is the place for you! At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions.

Minimum Requirements

15+ years of experience in a technical sales role (e.g., solutions consulting/engineering/architecture), including 10+ years in a technical pre-sales leadership position, with a focus on billing, revenue recognition, or related financial solutions.
Proven experience building and scaling world-class solutions architecture teams, managing individual contributors, and developing high-performance organizations in SaaS or consumption-based businesses.
Deep understanding of subscription models, billing systems, and revenue recognition principles.
Strong understanding of developing human-centric CX experiences, enterprise systems, and architecture, particularly in the context of revenue management.
Proven experience working across global markets, with deep familiarity with the business and cultural dynamics of AMER, EMEA, and APAC.
Passionate about coaching and developing others to their highest potential, with strong people management skills.
Excellent communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex revenue management concepts to diverse audiences.
Exceptional interpersonal skills for communicating and collaborating with both business and technical stakeholders at all levels within an organization.
Strong executive presence and ability to foster deep relationships with customers, particularly in the context of revenue solutions.
Self-starter who is adaptable and flexible, able to work and thrive in a highly dynamic environment.
Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time.

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $299,800 - $449,600. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

jobs.title: Head of Production, Compute & Comms
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Role

We are seeking a Head of Production to own the strategic development, operational direction, and execution of production for high-volume compute devices. In this role, you will serve as both a strategic leader and a hands-on operator, responsible for defining and driving the future success of the production portfolio and ensuring consistent, flawless execution across engineering, supply chain, and contract manufacturing. You will own the end-to-end relationship with contract manufacturers (CMs), lead the transition from New Product Introduction (NPI) through to sustained high-rate mass production, and build supply chain resilience — all while ensuring operational excellence, scalability, and adherence to rigorous quality and cost targets.

What You'll Do

Contract Manufacturer Management (High-Volume Compute)

Own CM Relationships & Performance: Own the relationship, performance, and output of contract manufacturers producing compute devices at high volume. Drive CM communications, onboarding, capacity planning, and new product introduction (NPI) through to mass production ramp.
KPI Management: Establish and manage KPIs across yield, quality, cost, throughput, and on-time delivery; hold CM partners accountable to them. Use data to drive continuous improvement and business impact.
Production Ramps: Lead production ramps and volume transitions across multiple CM sites and geographies, ensuring on-time delivery against aggressive targets.

Supply Chain Management

Supply Chain Strategy: Own supply chain strategy for high-volume production: demand/supply planning, component sourcing, inventory management, and logistics.
Risk & Resilience: Build resilience against component shortages, single-source risk, and geopolitical or lead-time disruption.
Component Sourcing: Partner with procurement and engineering to secure allocation of critical and long-lead components at scale.

Contract Negotiation

Manufacturing Agreements: Negotiate manufacturing agreements, pricing, capacity commitments, SLAs, and cost-down roadmaps with CMs and suppliers.
Commercial Terms: Structure commercial terms that protect margin, ensure supply, and align partner incentives with volume and quality targets.
Cost Reduction: Drive year-over-year cost reduction through negotiation, design-for-cost, and competitive sourcing.

Strategic & Operational Leadership

Executive Partnership: Serve as the production voice to the executive team and board; translate operational status, risk, and trade-offs into clear executive-level recommendations. Act as a key partner to Anduril's SVP of Manufacturing and broader Executive Leadership, contributing to company-wide production strategy and vision.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Procurement, Quality, Program Management, Deployment Operations, and Finance to align production plans with company goals and ensure seamless product maturation and delivery.
Talent & Team Building: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing production/operations organization. Attract, develop, and retain top-tier talent, fostering a culture of ownership and excellence.
Process & Systems Excellence: Establish, mature, and continuously refine manufacturing processes, operational playbooks, and systems to enable efficient scaling and consistent quality.
Digital Manufacturing Infrastructure: Advise on development and oversee implementation of digital technologies — including PLM, ERP, MES, and QMS — that enable production operations to scale efficiently while meeting customer requirements.
Compliance & Standards: Ensure adherence to applicable industry standards (e.g., AS9100D) and all relevant safety, regulatory, and environmental requirements.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of progressive leadership in high-volume production of compute or electronics hardware (servers, data center infrastructure, or comparable devices), scaling products from prototype to full-rate production.
Proven track record managing contract manufacturers / EMS partners at scale, including NPI-to-mass-production ramps. Direct ownership of at least one new product ramp through full-rate production.
Deep supply chain management expertise — planning, sourcing, risk mitigation, procurement, and warehousing functions essential to high-volume hardware manufacturing.
Demonstrated contract negotiation skill with CMs and suppliers (pricing, capacity, SLAs, cost-down).
Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and partner with C-level leadership and the board.
Experience managing a workforce of 100+ employees across quality, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, operations, and technicians.
Experience managing a P&L in a production environment, including capital expenditure forecasting and resource allocation.
Demonstrated strategic thinking and strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to understand how problems and solutions integrate within the broader organization.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or related technical field; advanced degree a plus. Equivalent practical experience with a proven track record considered.
Must be eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience scaling a new compute product line from launch through high-volume production (on the order of thousands of units annually).
Global CM/supplier management experience across multiple regions.
Background blending in-house and outsourced manufacturing models.
Experience with complex electromechanical systems in a deeply technical industry such as aerospace, defense, consumer electronics, or data center infrastructure.

US Salary Range

$261,000—$346,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.

ADVANCE YOUR CAREER. ADVANCE THE WORLD.

At AMD, we believe technology can change lives for the better. It can heal us, entertain us, and make us more connected, productive, and understanding of the world around us. And we’re looking for talent who feel the same: people who want to leave the planet better than they found it, those who don’t shy away from humanity’s challenges but are determined to help solve them.

AMD is powering the next generation of supercomputing, high-performance computing, cloud, and AI. Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or creating go-to-market plans, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward.

The Role

This is a manager role for ASIC Hardware and Firmware Co-Verification Engineering role with the Security IP Team (SECIP) in AMD . The primary focus of this role is to Lead and Manage the team responsible for Hardware/Firmware co-verification of various embedded micro-processor subsystems and the associated hardware accelerators in leading edge SOC’s. The preferred candidate will also have proven experience in Firmware based HW verification and the ability to contribute to Firmware development initiatives. These IP subsystems provide high performance functions to the respective SoC, such as security policy management, cryptography, data compression, high throughput DMA, etc.

The Person

The ideal candidate has experience leading others in technical and managerial settings. You also have excellent communication, writing, and presentation skills.  

Key Responsibilities

Lead a high-performance engineering team
Form a team and nurture talent
Lead team, meet schedule commitments and provide strong support to customers
Collaborate with multi-functional leaders to drive AMD's success 
Responsible to performance review , career development for team member .
Managed the team that is responsible for implementing / executing below task
Hardware/Firmware co-verification in UVM System Verilog and C-DPI structured testbench.
Hardware/Firmware co-verification in FPGA hardware prototype platform.
Develop and maintain subsystem verification architecture, testbench, test methodology for
Embedded CPU and subcomponent IPs with
AXI/AHB busses and HW accelerators such as
Cryptography, Data Compression, DMA, etc.
Participate in subsystem specification, influence IP micro-architecture development (HW and FW co-design and verification aspect), develop and verify abstracted performance model
Create abstracted FW and HW performance models
Develop critical target code to collect IP performance key parameters
Explore subsystem architecture performance trade-off for FW and HW optimization
Drive team to Develop and execute subsystem and block level test plans
Develop FW/HW co-verification methodology
Develop UVC and System Response models
Develop and debug UVM and C-DPI test cases with integrated FW
Improve verification metrics
Further develop subsystem and block level testbenches using UVM randomized test methodology and C-DPI directed test methodology.
Develop and maintain subsystem level integration scripts
Develop and maintain subsystem testbench build and test run scripts
Drive to verification metrics closure
Interface with SoC integration and SoC DV teams
Define and develop IP level DV API to support SoC level DV effort
Develop and maintain IP build and delivery infrastructure to support SoC level integration of SMU IPs.
Support SoC level IP emulation, silicon bring-up and debugging effort

Preferred Experience

A strong leader with experience working with a distributed team 
Strong mentoring and coaching skills
Proven experience managing and leading engineering teams

Strong communications skills. Able to summarize complex problems for executives as well as drill down to details with architects and engineers

new_jobs.title: Global Head of Specialist Solutions Architecture, Billing
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Specialist Solutions Architecture (Revenue Suite) team is dedicated to being trusted partners to Stripe customers, partners, and product/engineering teams. We focus on understanding our customers' needs and helping them achieve their business goals through our suite of revenue management solutions. Our team develops shared visions, establishes joint accountability, and prioritizes long-term success for our customers. We recognize that every customer's success increases the GDP of the internet and accelerates Stripe's growth.

What You'll Do

As the Global Head of Specialist Solutions Architecture for Revenue, you will have a significant impact on Stripe's future success. You will be responsible for building and leading the global Specialist Solutions Architecture team, with the opportunity to scale the organization as the business grows. This role combines deep product expertise with global leadership, positioning you to drive Stripe's success across all markets.

Responsibilities

Define and execute Stripe's technical sales strategy for our revenue suite in collaboration with sales leaders, marketing, professional services, GTM partner team, and product engineering.
Build repeatable playbooks and define execution best practices for our billing and revenue recognition offerings.
Recruit, mentor, develop, and inspire team members to do the best work of their careers, focusing on deep domain expertise in billing and revenue recognition.
Influence the mindset of CXOs, developers, architects, and other technical decision-makers, helping shape their long-term architectural direction for revenue management.
Champion the voice of our customers and influence product direction and priorities within the revenue management ecosystem.
Partner with Sales, Professional Services, Support, and Product Engineering to guide the customer journey from business and technical discovery to successful adoption, value realization, and expansion.
Drive thought leadership through presentations at EBCs, industry events, and by developing whitepapers and reference architectures focused on revenue management best practices.
Foster cross-regional collaboration and knowledge sharing across AMER, EMEA, and APAC to ensure consistent excellence globally.

Who you are

If you're passionate about people, ideas, and embracing the unknown, if you see setbacks as chances to learn and grow, and if you believe in the power of focused effort to drive progress—then this is the place for you! At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions.

Minimum Requirements

15+ years of experience in a technical sales role (e.g., solutions consulting/engineering/architecture), including 10+ years in a technical pre-sales leadership position, with a focus on billing, revenue recognition, or related financial solutions.
Proven experience building and scaling world-class solutions architecture teams, managing individual contributors, and developing high-performance organizations in SaaS or consumption-based businesses.
Deep understanding of subscription models, billing systems, and revenue recognition principles.
Strong understanding of developing human-centric CX experiences, enterprise systems, and architecture, particularly in the context of revenue management.
Proven experience working across global markets, with deep familiarity with the business and cultural dynamics of AMER, EMEA, and APAC.
Passionate about coaching and developing others to their highest potential, with strong people management skills.
Excellent communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex revenue management concepts to diverse audiences.
Exceptional interpersonal skills for communicating and collaborating with both business and technical stakeholders at all levels within an organization.
Strong executive presence and ability to foster deep relationships with customers, particularly in the context of revenue solutions.
Self-starter who is adaptable and flexible, able to work and thrive in a highly dynamic environment.
Willingness to travel up to 30% of the time.

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $299,800 - $449,600. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

new_jobs.title: Head of Production, Compute & Comms
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Role

We are seeking a Head of Production to own the strategic development, operational direction, and execution of production for high-volume compute devices. In this role, you will serve as both a strategic leader and a hands-on operator, responsible for defining and driving the future success of the production portfolio and ensuring consistent, flawless execution across engineering, supply chain, and contract manufacturing. You will own the end-to-end relationship with contract manufacturers (CMs), lead the transition from New Product Introduction (NPI) through to sustained high-rate mass production, and build supply chain resilience — all while ensuring operational excellence, scalability, and adherence to rigorous quality and cost targets.

What You'll Do

Contract Manufacturer Management (High-Volume Compute)

Own CM Relationships & Performance: Own the relationship, performance, and output of contract manufacturers producing compute devices at high volume. Drive CM communications, onboarding, capacity planning, and new product introduction (NPI) through to mass production ramp.
KPI Management: Establish and manage KPIs across yield, quality, cost, throughput, and on-time delivery; hold CM partners accountable to them. Use data to drive continuous improvement and business impact.
Production Ramps: Lead production ramps and volume transitions across multiple CM sites and geographies, ensuring on-time delivery against aggressive targets.

Supply Chain Management

Supply Chain Strategy: Own supply chain strategy for high-volume production: demand/supply planning, component sourcing, inventory management, and logistics.
Risk & Resilience: Build resilience against component shortages, single-source risk, and geopolitical or lead-time disruption.
Component Sourcing: Partner with procurement and engineering to secure allocation of critical and long-lead components at scale.

Contract Negotiation

Manufacturing Agreements: Negotiate manufacturing agreements, pricing, capacity commitments, SLAs, and cost-down roadmaps with CMs and suppliers.
Commercial Terms: Structure commercial terms that protect margin, ensure supply, and align partner incentives with volume and quality targets.
Cost Reduction: Drive year-over-year cost reduction through negotiation, design-for-cost, and competitive sourcing.

Strategic & Operational Leadership

Executive Partnership: Serve as the production voice to the executive team and board; translate operational status, risk, and trade-offs into clear executive-level recommendations. Act as a key partner to Anduril's SVP of Manufacturing and broader Executive Leadership, contributing to company-wide production strategy and vision.
Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner cross-functionally with Engineering, Product, Procurement, Quality, Program Management, Deployment Operations, and Finance to align production plans with company goals and ensure seamless product maturation and delivery.
Talent & Team Building: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing production/operations organization. Attract, develop, and retain top-tier talent, fostering a culture of ownership and excellence.
Process & Systems Excellence: Establish, mature, and continuously refine manufacturing processes, operational playbooks, and systems to enable efficient scaling and consistent quality.
Digital Manufacturing Infrastructure: Advise on development and oversee implementation of digital technologies — including PLM, ERP, MES, and QMS — that enable production operations to scale efficiently while meeting customer requirements.
Compliance & Standards: Ensure adherence to applicable industry standards (e.g., AS9100D) and all relevant safety, regulatory, and environmental requirements.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of progressive leadership in high-volume production of compute or electronics hardware (servers, data center infrastructure, or comparable devices), scaling products from prototype to full-rate production.
Proven track record managing contract manufacturers / EMS partners at scale, including NPI-to-mass-production ramps. Direct ownership of at least one new product ramp through full-rate production.
Deep supply chain management expertise — planning, sourcing, risk mitigation, procurement, and warehousing functions essential to high-volume hardware manufacturing.
Demonstrated contract negotiation skill with CMs and suppliers (pricing, capacity, SLAs, cost-down).
Strong executive presence with the ability to influence and partner with C-level leadership and the board.
Experience managing a workforce of 100+ employees across quality, supply chain, manufacturing engineering, operations, and technicians.
Experience managing a P&L in a production environment, including capital expenditure forecasting and resource allocation.
Demonstrated strategic thinking and strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to understand how problems and solutions integrate within the broader organization.
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or related technical field; advanced degree a plus. Equivalent practical experience with a proven track record considered.
Must be eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience scaling a new compute product line from launch through high-volume production (on the order of thousands of units annually).
Global CM/supplier management experience across multiple regions.
Background blending in-house and outsourced manufacturing models.
Experience with complex electromechanical systems in a deeply technical industry such as aerospace, defense, consumer electronics, or data center infrastructure.

US Salary Range

$261,000—$346,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers.
